subject.title: fix(ollama): bound model pull body reads past idle timeout

question: Should OpenClaw preserve compatibility with active status-only `/api/pull` streams, or intentionally fail them after the bounded no-progress window when `completed` does not advance?
rationale: The upstream API documentation does not establish aggregate `completed` growth as a mandatory liveness signal, so the fail-closed behavior is a product compatibility decision rather than a mechanical timeout correction. citeturn0search1turn0search2

options.title: Preserve status-only compatibility
options.body: Define a documented liveness signal or owner-controlled cancellation boundary that does not reject an otherwise active status-only pull.

options.title: Fail closed on absent progress fields
options.body: Keep the watchdog policy, but explicitly document unsupported status-only behavior and add compatibility tests and user-facing failure guidance.

recommendation.title: Preserve status-only compatibility
recommendation.body: Define a documented liveness signal or owner-controlled cancellation boundary that does not reject an otherwise active status-only pull.
